scripts.auth:pull: git fetch --no-tags goobits-auth refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/goobits-auth/main && git subtree pull --prefix=packages/auth goobits-auth main --squash
scripts.auth:push: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet || (echo 'Working tree is dirty; commit or stash before pushing subtree.' && exit 1); git subtree push --prefix=packages/auth goobits-auth main
scripts.build: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && NODE_ENV=production vite build
scripts.build:cf: git lfs version && git lfs pull && pnpm build
scripts.build:patch: pnpm run version:patch && pnpm run build
scripts.check: pnpm run check:types && pnpm run check:svelte && pnpm run check:lint && pnpm run check:circular
scripts.check:circular: pnpm exec madge --circular --extensions ts,js,svelte src packages serverless ops tasks --exclude "(^|/)dist/|^packages/auth/"
scripts.check:lint: pnpm exec eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern src packages repos serverless scripts ops tasks *.config.js *.config.ts
scripts.ci:gate: pnpm run check && pnpm run e2e:critical
scripts.dev: dotenvx run -f config/env/.env -- bash scripts/dev/dev-server.sh start
scripts.dev:restart: dotenvx run -f config/env/.env -- bash scripts/dev/dev-server.sh restart
